test_cases.path_step: The Teacher removes a student from the course by locating the student in the list, clicking the 'Delete Student Button' next to their name, and confirming the action in the confirmation dialog.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 4: BULK STUDENT MANAGEMENT AND REMOVAL - Phase 4: Test Student Removal
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher removes an existing student from the course list.
test_cases.pre_condition: A teacher is logged into the system and has navigated to the 'Students' tab of the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. The student 'student_valid_1@example.com' is currently enrolled in this course.
test_cases.expected_result: The student 'student_valid_1@example.com' disappears from the course's student list. The system displays the updated student list, reflecting the removal. The outcome is successful (True).
test_cases.post_condition: The student 'student_valid_1@example.com' is no longer enrolled in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. The teacher remains on the 'Students' tab of the course details page.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course in the Course List.
Click the 'Students' tab to navigate to the student management interface.
Click the 'Delete Student Button' next to 'student_valid_1@example.com'.
Confirm the deletion action in the confirmation dialog by clicking 'Confirm'.

test_cases.groups_involved: Add Students - Tabs, Add Multiple Students, Add Students From File
